key_highlights: ASX suffers sharp correction following global equity selloff, wiping $169B off local valuations in a grim week.
Aussie flash PMI contracts into recessionary territory alongside surging short positions against the AUD.
Chinese property market slump heightens downside risks for bulk commodity exporters like BHP and Rio Tinto.
Retail restructuring intensifies as David Jones cuts 1,700 jobs amid aggressive market share gains by Myer (MYR.AX).
Junior and mid-tier gold exploration in WA shows resilience with new discoveries and processing milestones.

sectors.trend: Bearish headwinds for iron ore majors due to Chinese real estate distress, offset by selective junior gold project advances in WA.
sectors.implications: Downside margin pressure on iron ore heavyweights (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX); junior gold explorers and producers offer tactical safe-haven support.

sectors.trend: Borrower stress rises under cumulative rate hikes while calls grow to ease APRA mortgage serviceability buffers.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin compression and credit impairment risks rise for major retail banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Severe margin squeeze and downsizing across department stores and discretionary retail as household budgets contract.
sectors.implications: David Jones workforce reductions signal distress, while Myer (MYR.AX) captures supplier share; cautious outlook for consumer exposure (WES.AX).

sectors.trend: Persistent structural gas supply deficits and grid bottlenecks as AI data centre power demands clash with renewables targets.
sectors.implications: Elevated domestic wholesale energy costs support upstream producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) but raise operating expenses for energy-intensive sectors.

sectors.trend: Federal policy capping PBS co-payments at $25 reinforces regulatory price constraints across pharmaceutical distribution.
sectors.implications: Neutral-to-defensive earnings profile for large caps (CSL.AX); mixed margin dynamics for retail pharmacy distributors and generic manufacturers.

sectors.trend: Selective resilience in diversified development assets despite broad macro and commercial real estate valuation headwinds.
sectors.implications: Lendlease (LLC.AX) rallies counter-cyclically, but high interest rate environments remain a hurdle for leveraged property trusts (GMG.AX, SCG.AX).

key_themes: Macro stagflation and flash PMI contraction indicating Australian private sector slowdown.
Record short positions on the Australian dollar reflecting global risk aversion and commodity demand doubts.
Chinese real estate deflation impacting Australian bulk export price realisations.
Household debt vulnerability following aggressive monetary tightening cycles.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocations to defensive dividend plays and cash equivalents; reduce exposure to cyclical discretionary equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese Real Estate Solvency & Commodity Price Slump
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-cost bulk miners; hedge iron ore exposure via derivatives or gold-linked instruments.
Rotate from pure retail-lending banks toward diversified financial asset managers or fixed income securities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Gas and Energy Cost Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Target uncontracted upstream gas suppliers and maintain energy efficiency buffers in industrial holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on gold sector momentum and project milestones in Western Australia
opportunities.rationale: High gold prices and active project commissioning provide revenue resilience amid broader market correction.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to consolidating retail market winners
opportunities.rationale: Myer gains supplier base and market share amidst competitor restructuring at David Jones.

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive upstream energy plays facing domestic supply shortfall
opportunities.rationale: Tight east coast gas markets and elevated prices provide cash-flow stability for major producers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge core ASX 200 exposure against global spillover and PMI weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: Wall Street correction and local flash PMI contraction elevate drawdown risk across headline indices.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce allocation to Big Four retail banking majors
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage buffer strain and high household debt serviceability limit credit expansion and risk provisioning hikes.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore pure-plays exposed to Chinese property deflation
defensive_moves.rationale: Deepening Chinese real estate downturn weakens steel mill profitability and seaborne iron ore demand.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and defensive 1–3 month trajectory as the ASX 200 digests global equity de-rating, weak domestic flash PMIs, and heavily shorted AUD.
market_outlook.long_term: Challenging 6–12 month outlook anchored by RBA interest rate lag effects on consumption, property sector adjustments, and structural commodity shifts.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statements and mortgage buffer guidance from APRA
Chinese stimulus policy announcements targeting real estate stabilisations
Australian quarterly GDP and CPI prints assessing recession probability
Wall Street equity volatility and US monetary trajectory
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate movements and speculative short positioning

Major bank loan arrears and credit quality metrics
